summary: Cubiks-2048 is a browser-based puzzle game that translates the traditional sliding tile mechanics of 2048 into a three-dimensional playing space. Players combine matching numbered cubes on a multi-axis grid to reach higher numerical values until no moves remain. It is implemented entirely in JavaScript.
goodFor: Casual deployment on a personal web server for users looking for a straightforward, lightweight browser game.
watchOut: The project lacks recent development activity and tagged releases, and the non-commercial licence restricts how you can reuse or distribute the code.
deployNotes: As a static JavaScript application, it typically only requires a basic web server to serve the asset files and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
